page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top centre; no marginal notes; catchword "quos" at lower right.

main_text.p: Dei dotes, honore inuicem præue-nire, ex amore decet. Lignum, lapi-des, stannum, æs, ferrum, argentum, & aurum ex quibus imagines fiunt, etiam sunt in suo genere bona. Sculpturæ tamen, conflaturæ, pictVRÆ aut huiusmodi aliæ artificum inuen-tiones non sunt à fidelibus adoran-dæ, quamtumlibet à magistratibus approbatæ, & ordinatæ ut sint eorū calendaria, qui nec Deum in uerbo, nec in creaturis laudant, nec ex mi-randis eius operibus glorificant in forma, quam homo creaturis infert, horum, inquam, nihil potest absque idolomania adorari, cum res sint ita expertes formarum, quas Deus im-presserit. Archiepiscopus. Assenti-or imagines propter se non colen-das, sed propter figuras impressas, uel propter id, quod foris exprimūt, puta, crucifixum propter Christi pas-sionem, & imaginē Trinitatis, diuæ Mariæ, ac sanctorum propter eos quos

page.notes: The page is slightly cropped at the left and bottom; the first word of the page is a fragment-free start. Some letters are doubtful due to print quality, notably "pictVRÆ" which should read "picturæ" and "potest" with long s to be plain s; "quos" catchword is at the right foot. No page number is printed.
